title: Fourteen teams was the right call for the WSL

defects.quote: back in the top tier of the women's game after 16 years away
defects.correction: Charlton returned to the top tier after 18 years away; they were relegated from the FA Women's Premier League National Division in 2008.
defects.note: [needs-source] True value: 18 years (relegated in 2008, promoted in May 2026). Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026%E2%80%9327_Women%27s_Super_League

defects.correction: The attendance for Arsenal 1-1 Manchester United on 19 September 2026 was 29,853.
defects.note: [needs-source] [multi-part] True value: 29,853. The score and the date in the same sentence are right; only the attendance is wrong. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026%E2%80%9327_Women%27s_Super_League

defects.quote: London City Lionesses beat Manchester United 3-1 in the opening round
defects.correction: London City Lionesses beat Manchester United 2-1 in the opening round of the 2026-27 season.

defects.quote: with Victoria Pelova scoring a hat-trick
defects.correction: Olivia Holdt scored the hat-trick in Tottenham's 7-0 win at Crystal Palace on 20 September 2026; Victoria Pelova did not.
defects.note: [needs-source] [multi-part] True value: Olivia Holdt. The score and the date in the first half of the sentence are right; only the hat-trick scorer is wrong (Pelova is a Tottenham team-mate). Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026%E2%80%9327_Women%27s_Super_League

defects.quote: Clubs who move there women's team into the main stadium sell four times as many season tickets within two years.
Attendances are up at the biggest clubs, so the expansion has plainly worked for every club in the league.
defects.known_rebuttal: Crowds at the biggest clubs say nothing about the clubs the expansion added. After five rounds the three promoted sides had one win between them from fifteen games, and Charlton had lost all five with two goals scored and fifteen conceded. The same weekend that produced a five-figure crowd at the Emirates produced one of 1,274 at Crystal Palace. Arsenal were already filling the Emirates before the league grew, so the big gates are not an effect of expansion, and five rounds is far too small a sample to judge a structural change.

defects.quote: Things do not change; we change.
defects.source_title: Walden, and On The Duty Of Civil Disobedience by Henry David Thoreau

defects.note: [needs-source] True: attendance 1,274, Crystal Palace 1-0 Everton, 6 September 2026. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026%E2%80%9327_Women%27s_Super_League

defects.note: [needs-source] True: Marc Skinner left on 3 August 2026 and Eva Olid was appointed on 5 August 2026. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026%E2%80%9327_Women%27s_Super_League
